summary: Completed e2e backend + frontend testing of LUXÉLLE skincare/perfume e-commerce site. All 7 backend pytest tests pass (brands, products with new/bestseller filters, newsletter subscribe/duplicate/invalid). Frontend renders all sections (nav, hero, trust, 4 brands, 4 newest + 4 bestseller products, philosophy, newsletter, footer). All nav links smooth-scroll, hero CTAs scroll correctly, newsletter success/error toasts work, mobile menu toggles. Zero JS page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') - prefer FastAPI lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
Brand/Product seed data is hardcoded in server.py rather than seeded into MongoDB - acceptable for MVP showcase but limits admin CRUD.
Newsletter endpoint returns 200 for 'already_subscribed' instead of 409 Conflict; current behavior aligns with the requested spec so kept as-is.
seed_data_creation: Newsletter test emails created with unique uuid prefixes (test_xxx@luxelle-test.com, dup_xxx@luxelle-test.com) in MongoDB newsletter collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All API endpoints (/api/brands, /api/products, /api/products?filter=new|bestseller, /api/newsletter) verified. Product card testid format is lx-product-{section-id}-{idx} (e.g. lx-product-newest-0), NOT lx-product-card-. Brand cards use lx-brand-card-{idx}. Hero CTAs use lx-hero-cta-primary/secondary. Mobile menu toggle: lx-nav-mobile-toggle. Nav links: lx-nav-link-{newest|bestsellers|maisons|philosophy|newsletter} (desktop) and lx-nav-link-mobile-{id} (mobile).
